strengths: Open-source positioning captures 'privacy' and 'self-hosted' long-tail traffic with low competition
Tool-based SEO opportunity (embedded VDOT calculator, pace calculator, training load charts) attracts high-intent visitors
Programmatic SEO potential for race-specific pages (city + marathon training plan)
API/integration content can rank for developer-oriented queries
Niche focus on running analytics avoids saturated general fitness market
weaknesses: Low domain authority compared to established competitors (Runner's World, Strava, Garmin)
No existing backlink profile from running/fitness publishers
Limited social proof and runner community traction
Brand awareness near zero outside self-hosted/dev communities
Product-centric pages lack informational content that drives top-of-funnel traffic
